fixes.what: Add `media="(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)"` to the `tree-full.webp` `<link rel="preload">` tag.
fixes.why: Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, both `hero-poster-small.jpg` and the large `tree-full.webp` are preloaded simultaneously, competing for initial bandwidth with critical fonts.

fixes.what: When `location.hash` is present on page load, pass `immediate: true` or skip the smooth scroll animation in `scrollToEl` during the initial hash-landing timeout.
fixes.why: Ensure hash landings always jump immediately to the offset without any delay or visual slide if the native browser jump was slightly off due to sticky headers.

fixes.what: Add `will-change: transform;` only inside `html.canopy-motion .tree__shake` instead of unconditionally on `.tree__shake`.
fixes.why: Avoids holding an unnecessary composited GPU layer when motion is paused or disabled via reduced-motion preferences.
